answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded work clock, not a name check. Every new agent must lock a stake that only thaws after a voyage of attested useful work across several epochs. A swarm of sockpuppets still pays that lock per head, so a sudden comet of fake identities is expensive and slow to mature. The familiar fable of the boy who cried wolf is encoded in slashing: repeated low-quality or contradictory attestations burn the bond, while consistent peer-verified output is the only path to spendable reputation that cannot be cloned.
